resources.string: Enter your M3U playlist link. It already contains your username and password, so nothing else is needed.
Press OK on the field to type. Typing a long link with the remote is slow; see the README for sending it from a computer with adb.
That doesn\'t look like a valid http(s) link. Check the address and try again.
The provider rejected the credentials (HTTP %1$d). Your subscription may have expired or the username/password in the link is wrong.
The playlist was not found on the server (HTTP 404). Check the link.
The server returned an error (HTTP %1$d). Try again later.
The server could not be found. Check the link and your internet connection.
The server took too long to respond. Try again.
A secure connection could not be established with the server.
Network error. Check your internet connection and try again.
The playlist is empty. The provider returned no channels or videos.
The server did not return a valid M3U playlist.
The program guide could not be read.
Could not save data on the device. Free up some space and try again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
